subject: npmx Weekly #26
headline: npmx Weekly #26
intro: This week, we're celebrating significant milestones and impactful updates across our platform. Join us as we dive into the latest achievements and enhancements shaping the developer experience.

topics.title: Biome.js Milestone
topics.summary: @biomejs.dev has reached an impressive 10 million weekly downloads, showcasing its growing popularity and strong user engagement within the developer community.

topics.title: Magic-String Package Updates
topics.summary: The magic-string package has hit 140 million downloads per week with recent enhancements, including ESM-only support and better performance, reflecting ongoing improvements in our ecosystem.

topics.title: User Experience and Interface Updates
topics.summary: Recent PRs have added direct links to sponsorship tiers and a 'create new account' button on the PDS page, enhancing user interactions and accessibility on the npmx platform.
